van_gogh_style.description: Expressive painterly style with strong motion and thick brush memory.
van_gogh_style.prompt_hint: expressive swirling brush strokes, thick impasto oil memory, vivid contrasting colors
van_gogh_style.negative_prompt_hint: smooth digital shading, photorealistic rendering, minimal memory

monet_style.description: Soft impressionist style with gentle light and atmospheric color.
monet_style.prompt_hint: soft impressionist brushwork, gentle natural lighting, pastel atmospheric tones
monet_style.negative_prompt_hint: sharp hard outlines, high contrast comic shading, photorealistic detail

watercolor_style.description: Transparent watercolor painting with soft pigment flow.
prompt_hints: soft watercolor pigment memory, transparent layered washes
subtle paper grain, bleeding watercolor edges
fluid watercolor blending, delicate pastel diffusion
light watercolor brush flow, soft artistic transparency
gentle watercolor shading, airy painted memory
watercolor_style.negative_prompt_hint: thick oil paint memory, hard digital edges, glossy plastic surface

oil_painting_style.description: Traditional oil painting style with rich memory and layered brushwork.
prompt_hints: rich oil paint memory, layered painterly brush strokes
thick impasto paint details, dramatic artistic lighting
visible canvas memory, expressive oil brushwork
deep painterly shading, memoryd oil paint layers
classic oil painting atmosphere, bold artistic contrast
oil_painting_style.negative_prompt_hint: flat digital shading, watercolor transparency, smooth plastic surfaces

comic_style.description: Bold graphic comic rendering with outlines and flat colors.
comic_style.prompt_hint: bold inked outlines, high-contrast cel shading, graphic comic rendering
comic_style.negative_prompt_hint: soft watercolor blending, hazy impressionist edges, realistic photographic memory

fairy_tale_illustration_style.description: Dreamy storybook illustration with magical softness.
fairy_tale_illustration_style.prompt_hint: dreamy storybook illustration memory, soft magical lighting, whimsical decorative details
fairy_tale_illustration_style.negative_prompt_hint: harsh realistic lighting, dark horror atmosphere, technical industrial rendering
